Grading Rubric (10 pts, scaled to 80)

  • Manual identification and linking (4 pts): the 10 entities are correctly typed and every link points to the right record, or the absence is recorded.
  • Merged TEI file (4 pts): entities_merged.xml is well-formed, uses the right elements, and every @ref resolves.
  • Comparison and reflection (2 pts): the counts are honest and the reflection names at least one machine error, such as a wrong or invented link.
